test_objective: Check that a notification is sent when an entity is created and entityCreated notification trigger is configured

test_cases.name: 046_06_01 Check that a notification is sent with all matching entities
test_cases.doc: Check that a notification is sent when an entity is created and entityCreated notification trigger is configured
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/'
        method set to 'POST'
        Request Header['Content-Type'] set to 'application/ld+json' and
 payload defined in file: 'building-location-attribute.jsonld'
}
